raw.title: docs: add x-sensitive-data extension
raw.body:
**Summary**

This PR aims to add an `x-sensitive-data` extension to mark a schema property as sensitive so its value is masked in displayed examples and API responses.

This implements the proposal discussed here - https://github.com/OAI/OpenAPI-Specification/discussions/4330.

This is currently used here - https://github.com/Kong/spec-renderer/blob/main/docs/extensions.md#x-sensitive-data.
